{{Top}}
'''Forch Gomou''' was a reactor tender. When off-duty, Tips, still in their lead-impregnated protective gear, would frequent the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> an establishment in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="FF44">{{FactFile|44|COR 21-22|Coruscant &ndash; Outlander Club}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Forch Gomou was first mentioned in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 96|ninety-sixth]] issue of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]''.<ref name="FF96" />
